title: 약국에서 증상 말하고 약 사기: 핵심 어휘 10

fixes.problem: The sentence to translate was left in English. A Spanish-speaking learner should get it in Spanish.
fixes.fix: Traduce al coreano con dos oraciones cortas: "Tengo fiebre. Deme medicamento para el resfriado, por favor."

fixes.problem: The sentence the learner must translate into Korean was left in English instead of being translated into Indonesian, so Indonesian learners get an English prompt.
fixes.fix: Terjemahkan ke dalam bahasa Korea dengan dua kalimat pendek: "Saya demam. Tolong beri saya obat flu."

fixes.problem: The sentence the learner must translate was left in English instead of being translated into Portuguese.
fixes.fix: Traduza para o coreano em duas frases curtas: "Estou com febre. Por favor, me dê remédio para resfriado."

fixes.problem: 'Beginner (high)' was rendered as 中高级 (intermediate-high), which changes the level. It should mean the high end of the beginner level.
'ask for the right medicine' means to request the medicine, but 询问 means 'inquire about'. It should say 要, as line 2 does.
fixes.fix: 学习者可以用10个药店核心单词,通过'두통이 있어요'或'열이 나요'这样的简短句子向药剂师说明自己的症状,并用'○○ 주세요'来要合适的药。

fixes.problem: Missing article: 'Erkältungsmedikament' is a countable noun and cannot stand without an article, so the German sounds wrong.
fixes.fix: Könnte ich bitte ein Erkältungsmedikament bekommen?

fixes.problem: Wrong gender: in grammar terms, 'Partikel' is feminine (die Partikel), so 'den richtigen Partikel' is incorrect.
fixes.fix: Wähle in jeder Lücke die richtige Partikel (이 / 가): 기침( ) 나요. 그리고 콧물( ) 나요.

fixes.problem: The sentence to translate was left in English instead of German, so German learners get an English prompt.
fixes.fix: Übersetze ins Koreanische mit zwei kurzen Sätzen: "Ich habe Fieber. Bitte geben Sie mir ein Erkältungsmedikament."
